```{r read_data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
db <- read_csv(here("data/DNM1L_MitochondriaAnalyzer_datos average.csv"))
db <- db[,1:19]

id <- data.frame(
  Control = "Control",
  DNM1L = "DNM1L",
  OTHERMIT = "OTHERMIT",
  n1 = 7,
  n2 = 10,
  n3 = 7
)

# Expand each count into numbered names
id <- paste0(db$Class, unlist(
  lapply(id[4:6], function(n) {
    paste0(id$gene, "_", seq_len(n))
  })
))

db$Class <- as.factor(db$Class) 

db$id <- as.factor(id) 

# db$class <- relevel(db$class, ref = "DNM1L")

#Removing redundant variables:


db <- db |>
  select(-c("Count", "TotalArea", "Branches", "TotalPerimeter", "TotalBranchLength", "BranchJunctions", "BranchEndPoints")) 

db <- db |> clean_names() |> select(id, class, everything())
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
#  Creating repeated CV folds
set.seed(123)


X <- db %>% select(-id, -class)
y <- db$class



folds <- createMultiFolds(
  y = y,
  k = 5,
  times = 10
)

fold_data <- vector("list", length(folds))

for (i in seq_along(folds)) {

  train_idx <- folds[[i]]
  valid_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(db)), train_idx)

  # train_data <- db[train_idx, ]
  # valid_data <- db[valid_idx, ]

  train_X <- db[train_idx, ]
  valid_X <- db[valid_idx, ]
  # -------------------------

  # 
  # valid_X <- valid_data %>%
  #   select(id, class, all_of(selected_vars))

  


  # -------------------------
  # PCA ONLY on training
  # -------------------------

  pca_fit <- prcomp(

  )


  # -------------------------

    # selected_vars = selected_vars,
    pca_fit = pca_fit,
    train_pca = train_pca,
    valid_pca = valid_pca
  )
}
```

# Defining model training functions

```{r, eval=TRUE}


make_bound_plot <- function(mod, dat, pcx = 1, pcy = 2, alg = "Model") {
  set.seed(2024)
  
  # 1. Extract feature data and preprocessing object from model
  feature_data <- dat %>% select(-c(1, 2)) # Assumes cols 1 & 2 are non-features (e.g., id, class)
  preproc <- mod$preProcess
  
  # 2. Transform original data to PCA space
  pca_coords <- predict(preproc, feature_data)
  
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    X = pca_coords[, pcx],
    Y = pca_coords[, pcy],
    class = dat$class
  )
  
  # 3. Create grid in 2D PCA space
  x_seq <- seq(min(plot_df$X) - 1, max(plot_df$X) + 1, length.out = 100)
  y_seq <- seq(min(plot_df$Y) - 1, max(plot_df$Y) + 1, length.out = 100)
  grid <- expand.grid(X = x_seq, Y = y_seq)
  
  # Build full PCA grid (fill unselected components with 0 / mean)
  grid_full <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = nrow(grid), ncol = ncol(pca_coords)))
  colnames(grid_full) <- colnames(pca_coords)
  grid_full[, pcx] <- grid$X
  grid_full[, pcy] <- grid$Y
  
  # 4. Inverse PCA transformation back to original feature space
  rotation <- preproc$rotation
  center   <- if (!is.null(preproc$mean)) preproc$mean else rep(0, nrow(rotation))
  scale    <- if (!is.null(preproc$std)) preproc$std else rep(1, nrow(rotation))
  
  rotation_sub  <- rotation[, colnames(grid_full), drop = FALSE]
  grid_original <- as.matrix(grid_full) %*% t(rotation_sub)
  grid_original <- sweep(grid_original, 2, scale, `*`)
  grid_original <- sweep(grid_original, 2, center, `+`)
  
  grid_original <- as.data.frame(grid_original)
  colnames(grid_original) <- colnames(feature_data)
  
  # 5. Predict on original feature space
  grid$class <- predict(mod, newdata = grid_original)
  
  # 6. Plot decision regions and actual data points
  ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = grid, aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = class), alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = plot_df, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = class), size = 2.5, stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#a39b9b",  "#5c95ff", "#e76f51")) +    
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Prediction", values = c("#a39b9b", "#add9f4", "#f4a261")) +
    labs(
      title = paste(alg, "- Decision Boundary (PCA Space)"),
      x = paste("Principal Component", pcx),
      y = paste("Principal Component", pcy)
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}


```

```{r}

ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv",
  number = 5,
  repeats = 10,
  savePredictions = "final",
  summaryFunction = multiClassSummary, # Generates Macro F1, LogLoss, etc.
  classProbs = TRUE
)

# Shared preprocessing: Center, Scale, and PCA (computed strictly inside each fold)
pre_proc <- c("center", "scale", "pca")



# Model 1: Ridge Multinomial Regression

set.seed(123)
fit_glm <- train(
  class ~ ., data = db %>% select(-id),
  method = "glmnet",
  preProcess = pre_proc,
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 0, lambda = seq(0.01, 1, length = 10)),
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)

# Model 2: Linear SVM
set.seed(123)
fit_svm <- train(
  class ~ ., data = db %>% select(-id),
  method = "svmLinear",
  preProcess = pre_proc,
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(C = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10)),
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)

# Model 3: RBF SVM
set.seed(123)
fit_svm_radial <- train(
  class ~ ., data = db %>% select(-id),
  method = "svmRadialCost",
  preProcess = pre_proc,
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(C = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10)),
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)

# Model 4: Naive Bayes
set.seed(123)
fit_nb <- train(
  class ~ ., data = db %>% select(-id),
  method = "naive_bayes",
  preProcess = pre_proc,
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract Out-of-Fold Metrics & Compare
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
results <- resamples(list(
  Ridge_GLM = fit_glm,
  Linear_SVM = fit_svm,
  RBF_SVM = fit_svm_radial,
  Naive_Bayes = fit_nb
))


res_stat <- summary(diff(results))

tables <- lapply(res_stat$table, as.data.frame)

library(gridExtra)

for (metric in names(tables)) {
  p <- tableGrob(tables[[metric]], rows = NULL)

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(metric, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = max(3, nrow(tables[[metric]]) * 0.4),
    dpi = 300
  )
}

plot_data <- results$values |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Resample,
    names_to = c("model", "metric"),
    names_sep = "~",
    values_to = "value"
  )

bx_plot <- na.omit(plot_data) |>

ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/DNM1L/plots/average/bx_plot_summary_stats.png", bx_plot, width = 12, height = 12, units = "in")

#1. Extract the raw matrix from caret output
cm_matrix <- confusionMatrix(fit_svm)$table

# 2. Divide each column by its column sum (margin = 2) to get class proportions
class_pct <- prop.table(cm_matrix, margin = 2) * 100

# 3. Round to 1 decimal place
class_pct <- round(class_pct, 1)
df <- as.data.frame(class_pct)

# Create formatted ggplot heatmap
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Freq),
      color = Freq > 70
    ),
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "white"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#ebf2fa",
    mid = "#3498db",
    high = "#0f3a57",
    midpoint = 50,
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Out-of-Fold Confusion Matrix",
    x = "Actual Class (Reference)",
    y = "Predicted Class",
    fill = "Proportion"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(reverse = "y")

# Save directly to JPEG at 300 DPI
ggsave("/home/sofia/Projects/DNM1L/plots/average/confusion_matrix_heatmap.jpeg", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, units = "in")

tableGrob(tables$Accuracy, rows = NULL)
```
